curriculum.title: Capstone Project
points: Participants will develop a strategic framework for integrating AI, including Generative AI, into an organization that is looking to adopt AI. The project will begin with an assessment of existing processes and challenges to identify opportunities for value addition through Generative AI. Students will craft an AI strategy and outline a detailed implementation roadmap, addressing steps, potential risks, and mitigation strategies. The final deliverable will include a report and presentation that describe the strategic framework, supported by data and case studies, highlighting anticipated benefits for operational efficiency and competitive positioning.

points: Use Cases & Applications of No-Code AI

curriculum.title: Transforming Business using Agentic AI
points: Intro to Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems

curriculum.title: Capstone Project
points: Many organizations, especially SMEs, lack the technical expertise to build and deploy AI products. This project aims to bridge this gap by developing a generative AI solution using a no-code platform and integrating it into an organization's strategic initiatives. We will identify a suitable use case, select a no-code platform, design and develop the AI model, and deploy the solution. Additionally, we will integrate strategic initiatives like data governance, ethical AI, and risk management into the development and deployment process. The final deliverable will include the AI solution, a detailed technical report, and a presentation highlighting the benefits and strategic implications.

content.title: Is prior experience in Artificial Intelligence required for program enrollment?
content: No, the program is designed to be inclusive of all levels of experience. All topics will be covered from the basics, making it suitable for individuals from any field of work.

content.title: What is the minimum system configuration required?
content: ## Minimum System Requirements for the Program:
- **Processor: Any modern processor:** Intel Core i3 (10th Gen or newer) / AMD Ryzen 3 (3000 series or newer) / Apple M1 or later
- **Storage:** 256GB SSD or HDD (SSD preferred for faster performance)

content.title: How many projects can I anticipate working on?
content: In Executive Program in Leadership with AI you will have access to case studies and Capstone Projects to provide a better understanding of the real-world applications of Artificial Intelligence concepts.

content.title: What's the difference between case studies & projects?
content: Case studies are targeted towards concept validation and limited to only a single concept. However, projects are targeted to overall learning and are more of a combination of multiple topics.

content.title: What all topics are covered in the Executive Program in Leadership with AI?
How much time does one need to spend on a regular basis?
content: Ideally, 30 minutes of preparation time is recommended each day, but students can allocate time according to their own schedules. They can choose to practice, read, or watch videos. Additionally, students must attend live classes on weekends. The schedule for these classes will be shared in advance.

content.title: What is the duration of the program?
content: The duration of the program is 8 months, every term is approximately 4-5 weeks long.

content.title: How is the Executive Program in Leadership with AI program different?
content: ## This program is distinguished by three key elements:

- **Iterative Mastery Approach:** IITG's exclusive Iterative Mastery Approach ensures development through a step-by-step methodology, specifically designed to welcome individuals from diverse backgrounds. Whether you're seeking a lateral move in the industry or looking to broaden your skills, our program is tailored to empower you on your unique learning journey.

- **Versatile Skill Development Model:** IITG's unique framework ensures that every Artificial Intelligence concept is taught in the context of real-world industry problems. Our program goes beyond theory, emphasizing practical case studies to prepare students for the challenges they'll face in the professional arena.
- **Accredian Career Center:** Aligned with our mission to cultivate the leaders of tomorrow, the Accredian Career Center empowers you to confidently launch your career.

content.title: Tell me more about Career Assistance?
content: Accredian provides career assistance through the Career Launchpad program. Students gain hands-on experience as leaders in their chosen field with rigorous resume and portfolio building sessions. The program also covers creating a strong online presence and developing top-notch interview skills.
